'''Thaddeus Charles Young''' (born [[June 21]], [[1988]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[college]] [[basketball]] player for the [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets]]. He is currently a [[freshman]] and is studying [[Management]]. Standing 6 ft 8 in and weighing 217 pounds, Young is a [[small forward]] for the Yellow Jackets.<ref name="wreck">[http://ramblinwreck.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/young_thaddeus00.html Player Bio: Thaddeus Young], ramblinwreck.com, accessed [[14 February]] [[2007]]</ref> Young is considered to be a potential [[NBA Draft Lottery|lottery pick]] by major media outlets such as [[ESPN]] in the [[2007 NBA Draft]] should he decide to leave school early.<ref>[http://insider.espn.go.com/nbadraft/draft/tracker/player?playerId=19022&draftyear=2007 Thaddeus Young profile], espn.com, accessed [[February 15]], [[2007]] </ref>

==Biography==
===Early life and high school===
Young was born to Lula Hall and Felton Young in [[New Orleans, Louisiana]]. His family moved to [[Memphis, Tennessee]] when Young was in the [[fourth grade]]. His father played basketball for [[Jacksonville University]] from 1976 to 1978.<ref name="wreck"/>

Young began playing [[varsity team|varsity]] basketball in the [[eighth grade]], and while attending [[Mitchell High School]], he rose to the top of the high school player rungs. His athletic honors included being named to the all-state team three times, being named the Class AA "Mr. Basketball" in 2005, being named the 2006 Tennessee Gatorade Player of the Year and being named to the [[McDonald's High School All-American Team]]. In 2006, he led Mitchell's basketball team to the Class AA finals. As a [[twelfth grade|senior]], he averaged 26.9 [[point (basketball)|points]], 13.8 [[rebound (basketball)|rebounds]], 4.1 [[assist (basketball)|assists]], 4.3 [[steal (basketball)|steals]] and 3.6 [[block (basketball)|blocks]] per game. He was an excellent overall athlete at Mitchell who also excelled in [[cross country running|cross country]] in his [[eleventh grade|junior year]].<ref name="wreck"/> Young was an exceptional student at Mitchell who graduated with a 4.3 [[Grade Point Average|GPA]].<ref name="wreck"/><ref>[http://www.signonsandiego.com/sports/college_basketball/20061107-9999-1s7fabfrosh1.html Fab Frosh], signonsandiego.com, accessed [[February 15]], [[2007]] </ref> Coming out of high school Young was one of the most prized [[recruiting (athletic)|recruits]] of the 2006 freshman class.<ref>[http://www.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/stories/110905abb.html Tech Signs Four Basketball Players to Letters-of-intent], cstv.com, accessed [[February 15]], [[2007]] </ref>

===College===
Young is the youngest member of the team's 2006 freshman class.<ref name="wreck"/> Young finished his freshman season with averages of 14.4 points, 4.9 rebounds, and 2.2 assists.<ref name="stats">[http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/player/profile?playerId=31619 Thaddeus Young], espn.com, accessed [[May 2]], [[2007]]. </ref> He shot a solid 47.8% [[field goal percentage|from the field]] and an above average 41.9% from the [[three-point field goal|three-point]] line.<ref name="stats"/>
